WITH first_buyers_2007 AS (
    SELECT CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
    HAVING toYear(min(DateKey)) = 2007
),
returned_2008 AS (
    SELECT f.CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
    INNER JOIN first_buyers_2007 fb ON f.CustomerKey = fb.CustomerKey
    WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2008
    GROUP BY f.CustomerKey
),
returned_2009 AS (
    SELECT f.CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
    INNER JOIN returned_2008 r ON f.CustomerKey = r.CustomerKey
    WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY f.CustomerKey
)
SELECT
    count(DISTINCT fb.CustomerKey)  AS cohort_2007,
    count(DISTINCT r8.CustomerKey)  AS retained_in_2008,
    count(DISTINCT r9.CustomerKey)  AS retained_in_2009
FROM first_buyers_2007 fb
LEFT JOIN returned_2008 r8 ON fb.CustomerKey = r8.CustomerKey
LEFT JOIN returned_2009 r9 ON fb.CustomerKey = r9.CustomerKey
